report_summary: The report contains useful transfer, correction and explicit backup examples, and acknowledges weak vendor attribution and missing XSS responses. It nevertheless overstates unsolicited emergence, evaluation invalidation and proof of manual cleanup. Some exact numeric and infrastructure-provenance claims require substantially stronger methods than the supplied descriptions.
